Brief

READ FOR FULL DETAILS AND REQUIREMENTS

Laud Have Mercy — Clip & Earn Campaign

Help us introduce Laud Have Mercy, our feel-good family reality series, to new audiences!

Create engaging short-form clips from official Laud Have Mercy episodes and post them on your own social media accounts, entertainment/theme pages, or dedicated fan pages.

WHERE TO POST

Paid/eligible posting platforms:

TikTok
Instagram Reels
YouTube Shorts

HOW YOU GET PAID

Earn $1 per 1,000 verified views (CPM) on eligible, approved clips.

Views are verified through the applicable social platforms. No payment is made for fake, purchased, botted, or artificially generated views.

ELIGIBLE FAN & THEME PAGES

You may post clips on:

Your existing personal social media account
An existing entertainment, reality-TV, family-content, or theme page
A dedicated Laud Have Mercy fan page you create specifically for this campaign

You do not need to already have a large following to participate. The campaign rewards verified views rather than the size of your existing audience.

If you create a new Laud Have Mercy fan page:

The page must clearly be an unofficial fan page.
You may not present yourself as the official Laud Have Mercy account.
Do not use wording, logos, usernames, or profile information that could make viewers believe the page is officially operated by Laud Have Mercy unless specifically authorized.
The account must remain publicly viewable so eligible views can be verified.

OFFICIAL ACCOUNTS — TAGGING REQUIRED

Creators are required to tag the official Laud Have Mercy accounts on every eligible post, on every platform where tagging is available.

Instagram Reels:

Laud Have Mercy: @officiallaudhavemercy
Coco Laud: @cocolaud

TikTok:

Laud Have Mercy: @officiallaudhavemercy

YouTube Shorts:

Laud Have Mercy: Laud Have Mercy

Tagging the applicable official account is required for the clip to be eligible for payment.

CLIP REQUIREMENTS

Clips must come from an official Laud Have Mercy episode or official Laud Have Mercy content provided for this campaign.
Create short-form edits designed specifically for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.
Clips should have an engaging hook and be edited to encourage viewers to keep watching.
You may add your own captions, text, graphics, transitions, music, or other creative editing.
Your own commentary, reaction, or voiceover is allowed as long as it adds value and does not misrepresent the show or its cast.
AI-assisted captions, effects, and editing are allowed.
AI-generated people, dialogue, scenes, or events that falsely appear to be part of the show are not allowed.
Recommended clip length: 15–60 seconds.
Do not post misleading captions, thumbnails, titles, or descriptions.
Do not intentionally take moments out of context in a way that misrepresents what happened.
Keep clips positive, entertaining, and consistent with the Laud Have Mercy brand.

BRAND RULES

Tag @officiallaudhavemercy and @cocolaud on Instagram when posting.
Tag @officiallaudhavemercy on TikTok when posting.
Tag Laud Have Mercy on YouTube when posting.
Use the official campaign hashtag(s) provided in the campaign.
No profanity, hate speech, harassment, sexualized content, or other inappropriate material.
No misleading claims about the show or the family.
Do not create fake controversy or intentionally portray the family in a negative or deceptive way.
Do not use purchased, botted, or artificially generated views or engagement.
Do not use Instagram Collab/co-posting or equivalent co-posting features unless specifically permitted by the campaign.

ACCOUNT REQUIREMENTS

Clips must be posted publicly on TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube so that eligible views can be verified.

Creators may participate using a new dedicated Laud Have Mercy fan page, even if they do not already have an established audience.

IMPORTANT

Only clips that meet these campaign requirements and are approved/eligible for the campaign will qualify for payment.

Verified views determine CPM earnings, subject to the campaign’s available budget and payout limits.

Most importantly: Have fun with it! Find the funniest, sweetest, most relatable, surprising, memorable, or entertaining moments from Laud Have Mercy and help us introduce the family to the world. ❤️
